bundle.shortDescription: MC protocol (SLMP) server simulator for testing PLC communication
bundle.longDescription: PortDock PLC Simulator answers MC protocol (3E/4E frames, binary or ASCII) requests over TCP or UDP from editable device tables, so HMI and data-collection software can be tested without a PLC. Implemented from publicly available manuals; not affiliated with any PLC maker, and behaviour may differ from a real PLC.
